Poem of Creation (Enūma eliš) – Standard Babylonian II: “Tiamat Assembled Her Creatures”

  • Source: eBL corpus – https://www.ebl.lmu.de/corpus/L/1/2/Standard%20Babylonian/II
  • API: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/api/texts/L/1/2/chapters/Standard%20Babylonian/II/display
  • Edition: Adrian C. Heinrich (editor); Tonio D. N. Mitto (revision); Zsombor J. Földi (revision); Enrique Jiménez (revision)
  • Translation: Benjamin R. Foster
  • Generated by tools/ebl_fetch.py on 2026-10-16 – do not edit by hand; re-run the tool instead.

Per line: N = normalized Akkadian reconstruction (| metrical foot, || caesura); T = eBL English translation; L = lemmas with eBL dictionary glosses; then notes, parallel lines, and the manuscripts' transliterations (ATF). Bibliography keys like [RN117: 889] are resolved in bibliography.md (RN117 = George 2003).

1

  • N: ukappit-ma (||) tiāmtu | pitiqša
  • T: Tiamat assembled her creatures,
  • L: ukappit-ma ← kapātu I “O/jB”; tiāmtu ← Tiamat I; pitiqša ← pitēqu I “offspring jB lex.”
  • Note: The expected st. c. would be derived from pitēqu. But the spellings in MSS BabaNB1, BabaNB3, and BabaNBQuo1 suggests that the st. c. is here derived secondary form pitqu.
